title: unsubscribe — output
description: Output schema for the SOX unsubscribe operation. Reports which channels were actually removed from the agent's subscription list and how many queued messages were discarded. Normative reference: spec/primitives/channels.md §3.

unsubscribed.description: Channel names actually removed from the agent's subscription list. A channel is included here only if a matching subscription existed. Channels that were not subscribed are silently omitted.

pending_cleared.description: Count of queued-but-unread messages discarded from the agent's mailbox for the unsubscribed channels. These messages will not appear in future recv calls.
